product_metadata.title: 2 Pack - Evelots Oven Rack Liner-Extra Large-Non Stick Fiberglass-Reuse-500 Degrees
features: This set of 2 extra-large oven rack liners will keep your oven clean by catching drips, spills, and splatters from cooking food so that you spend less time scraping burned, baked-on sauces, glazes, grease, and gunk from the bottom of your oven. It can be cut to fit any size rack.
Easy to clean. Washable oven rack liners are made of non-stick Teflon-coated fiberglass to easily remove even sticky, burned food (hand washes only).
Reusable liners reduce waste and prevent the need for toxic chemicals, oven cleaners, and energy-intensive self-cleaning modes.
Extra-large oven rack liners cover a large area under baking dishes to catch spills. Each liner measures approximately 26.25 inches long x 15.75 inches wide - heat resistant up to 500 degrees F.
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.
